examples.description: Tic Tac Toe Smart AI contains exactly what the title says. Using an advanced game tree algorithm, the Hard AI analyzes all the moves it can make and chooses the best possible move. Hours of entertainment is guaranteed with this AI. 2 player mode and an Easy AI are also provided if you would like to play with a friend or play against an easier AI.

There are four square area, Each square contains 5 types of animals: Tiger, Pig, Mammoth, Duck, and Tortoise. There are also 4 covers with diverse shape, You should put these covers into the squares one by one, Then the area will display a number of animals. There are 50 questions totally, Each question will show some of animals. You should put the covers in different squares in order to get different animal numbers, If the number in bottom is same as in question, you are the winner. Don't take it easy, It has so many varieties, It is almost an animal labyrinth.

examples.description:
Defend Papi Tower from enemy missiles!

Many enemy missiles are coming to Papi Tower! Shoot Mr.Papi and break all the missiles to defend the tower.
Touch anywhere to increase launching power, and release to shoot! The longer you touch, the upper he goes.

- If you break many missiles at a time, you get more score.
- If all the barriers and tower are destroyed by missiles, the game is over.
- Sometimes a heart item comes. If he gets it, a destroyed barrier will be recovered.
- You can also control by pressing DPAD-center or a trackball.
